items.lang|foxablazeaqzl_wiki|foxablazeaqzl_wi:
"When a man learns to love, he must also bear the risk of carrying hate"

Passive
[Passive, Toggle] Eye of Insight - When toggled on, gain the effects of Thought Acceleration and Magic Sense. Drains 50 Magicules every 5 seconds that this is toggled on.
Passive: [Passive, True] Overuse:
Using abilities from this skill will build up a counter. If the counter hits 10, it will strain the user’s eyes, putting the entire skill on cooldown for 180 seconds while the user recharges.
Resting for 15 seconds after an ability usage will reset the counter to zero.
Passive: [Passive, True] Intangibility:
The next attack you take will be dodged with 100% chance. For 5 seconds, you are intangible and immune to all attacks, as they simply pass through you. This includes projectiles. However, this passive goes on a 15 second cooldown after.
Will build up the counter if this is triggered.
Active
[Active, Held/Press] Ejection:
Crouch and Press the ability key to open the ejection GUI. Store up to three different projectile types in your dimension here, up to 128 per stack.
Holding the key will spawn portals. The user must charge for 3 seconds before they can fire, otherwise the portals will not be fully opened.
Releasing the key forcefully ejects one projectile from EVERY SLOT in the GUI out at 3x speed than that of a bow would after a wind up, dealing increased damage. On mastery, you can now place 5 projectiles into your GUI.
Will build up the counter if this is triggered. Additionally, the charge time is halved on mastery.
Active: [Active, Held] Authority of the Gods:
Crouch using will allow you to bring yourself into the Kamui dimension over a period of time, determined by your player’s current size. For reference, a 2 block tall default sized player will take 2 seconds to warp into the dimension. Releasing crouch will cancel this process.
On mastery, double the speed that it would take to transfer you into the dimension. You can also now target other entities provided they are within your interaction range.
Will build up the counter if this is triggered.
Active: [Active (Mastery), Press] Intangibility: The user becomes able to control their intangibility. On pressing the key, become intangible for 5 seconds, allowing the user to walk straight through projectiles, as well as dodge ALL attacks. Cooldown of 10 seconds after it wears off.

Command your absolute authority over Acceleration, allowing you to inflict all enemies with fire and spew superheated flames. Additionally, melt the surroundings into magma.

Passive
[Passive, Toggle] Excitation - Raise your body temperature to inflict Fire Damage to all enemies you touch. Additionally, while in slot, all Flame attacks deal 2x more damage.
Active
[Active] Fire Breath - Spew superheated flames at your enemy which are 2x stronger than that of the intrinsic Fire Breath. Stacks with the passive.
Active: [Active] Providence - Instantly melt and turn all nearby (16x16) blocks into Lava. Does not work if there is water nearby. Works so long as the skillgrief gamerule is not on.

Instantly kill weakened enemies or drain the life force of those who lack the will to fight or of those much weaker than you.

Active
[Active - In Slot] - Soul Consume: Applies a debuff to the player's attacks that drains the afflicted mob/player's spiritual health at 10 per 10 ticks (this drain lasts 5s). Costs 100 MP for each attack by user [required to be in active skill slots]
Active: [Active - Hold] - Soul Steal: Instantly kills all mobs within a 30x30 radius that are below 10% HP, have an EP below 10% of the users maximum, or have at least a lvl 5 Fear debuff. Costs 100 MP

Embody the relentless pursuit of ascension, gathering and refining energy to reach unparalleled heights. A Cultivator walks the path of self-perfection and dominion over all.

Passive
[Passive, True] Heavens Favor - Changes the normal MP gain of 3% to 10% (15% on mastery) on killing a mob. Overrides any EP gamerules.
Passive: [Passive, In Slot] - Martial Prodigy - Battle wills can be learned instantly and gain a flat 50 (100 when mastered) to attack damage while holding no weapon in either hands.
Active
[Active, Press] Breakthrough - Every 1000 mob kills, you gain a Breakthrough level, allowing you to temporarily boost MP gain by 3x for 5 minutes. You also temporarily gain Strengthen 15 and Resistance 5 during these 5 minutes. After using Breakthrough, go on a 1 hour cooldown. Gain 100 mastery points every time you use Breakthrough.

Schrodinger? Like the cat?

Passive
[Passive, True] Nine Lives:
The player can respawn up to nine times if the world is set to hardcore. Check current lives using /tensura get ability check mysticism:schrodinger.
Passive: [Passive, True] Dead or Alive:
There is a 50% chance that the user does not lose Energy (and by extension, souls) when dying.
Passive: [Passive, Toggle] Feline Instincts:
The player's safe falling distance has been increased by 32 blocks. This means you will need to fall 32 blocks before you start taking half a heart of fall damage, etc. etc.
Passive: [Passive, In Slot] Poison Touch:
On hurting an enemy, apply Poison II to the target. On mastery, this becomes Fatal Poison II.

Erm actually

Passive
[Passive, Acquisition] Knowledge of the Ages:
On acquisition of [Scholar], the user instantly learns all Schematics, provided that the skill is permanent and not temporary.
Passive: [Passive, Toggle] Quick Reader - All of the user's learning and mastery speeds is increased by +6.
Passive: [Passive, In Slot] Study - On being attacked, you have a 20% chance by default to gain a Study Point for that specific attacker entity type. Each Study Point you have will increase your innate dodge chance towards that specific entity type up to a maximum of 50% (75% on mastery). Each Study Point increases your dodge chance for that entity type by 2%.
If the attacker is a player, you will instead gain dodge for THAT player, and not players in general. This can go up to 20% when unmastered, and 40% when mastered.
Active
[Active, Press] Library of Babel:
Open a book storage GUI. In this menu, the user may only deposit books, such as book and quills, normal books, written books or enchanted books.
By placing an enchanted book in a slot, the user may right click that slot to open an upgrading menu, allowing the user to choose which level they would like to upgrade or downgrade that book's level to.
Be mindful that upgrading a book utilises MAXIMUM magicules and not CURRENT.
This can go up to five levels past the limit, with the cost increasing for each level of enchantment.
Active: As of v.2.0.3, the Enchanted Book Upgrade does not function in 1.21.1.

Spill your own blood to summon a mist which steals the vitality of your enemies and can be blown up to harm any nearby entities or shoot a powerful blood beam.

Active
[Active - Press] - Default: creates a blood mist in a 10x10 area where the user is looking. Mobs inside the bloodmist take 10 HP a second and for each enemy damaged in this way the player heals 10 HP. The Bloodmist lasts for 30 seconds and if activated again before the 30 seconds is over it deals 100 damage to all mobs in range. Costs 500 MP and deals 20 HP in damage to the player on activation.
Active: [Active - Press] - Blood Ray: (Requires Mastery + 500k EP): Shoots a blood beam from the player that deals 50 magic damage every 10 ticks (40 block range) and breaks blocks on contact while held down at the cost of 10 HP and 10,000 MP each time.

Dominate gravity yourself, control attractive and repulsive forces or unleash devastating ranged attacks which will crush anyone unfortunate enough to be in your path.

Makes Gravity Manipulation Learnable.
Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Makes the player immune to fall damage and simple projectile (arrow, trident, kunai,...) with mastery [Toggle]. Repel, Attract, and Flicker are able to have their ranges manually selected with keys with mastery (0 = Hold like normal)
Active
[Active - Hold] - Repel: Repels the mob the player is looking at, pushing them away. The longer its held before releasing, the bigger the distance. Costs 50 MP
Active: [Active - Hold] - Attract: Attracts the mob the player is looking at, pulling them towards the player. The length its held down before releasing determines the distance pulled. Costs 50 MP
Active: [Active - Press] - Oppress: Traps the mob the player is looking at inside a gravity field that reduces their speed and jump strength to 5% as well as applying Burden 2 for 30 seconds. Each 10 seconds, add 1 level of insanity. If activated again while a mob is trapped, deals 100 (200 with Mastery) Damage (can be done repeatedly). Trapping a Mob costs 300 MP, dealing damage costs 700 MP. Cooldown 10s (5s if mastered)
Active: [Active - Press] - Bleve: Deals 100(200 with mastery) damage at the cost of 1000 MP to the mob the player is looking at and knocks them 10 blocks into the air.
Active: [Active - Hold] - Flicker: Pushes the player forward at high speed. The longer the button is held the farther they go when the button is released. Costs 50 MP.

Channel the powers of fire to burn all nearby foes.

Passive
Grants access to the Medium level of Flame Spirit Magic
Active
[Passive - Hold] - At the cost of 30 MP per 20 ticks held down and 50% speed, deal 2 fire damage and light all mobs on fire (and place fire where the target is) within a 10x10 radius.

Boosts the power of fire skills by a decent amount.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Increases damage dealt by Fire/Flame related attacks by 1.5x. Doesn't Stack with Flame Domination
Passive: [Passive - In Slot] - Coating: If the user is on fire: On tools it grants an autosmelt effect (ores into bars, wood into charcoal); on attacking enemies (melee and bows), set the target on fire for 5 seconds (10 if mastered)
Active
[Active - Hold] - Breathes fire. If user is burning, extinguishes the flames. 0 MP
Can be used infinitely if user has lava in spatial storage

Spew fire to burn away enemies and set fire to the land.

Active
[Active - Hold] - Flame Breath: AoE attack that deals 16 fire damage each second, and sets hit targets and terrain on fire. Has a Black Flame variant. Equivalent in power to fireball. Costs 50 MP per second

Boosts the power of fire skills by a large amount.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Increases damage dealt by Fire/Flame related attacks by 3x. Mastery grants Flame attack resistance/nullification degrade if the user has 800k EP. Doesn't Stack with Flame Manipulation
Passive: [Passive - In Slot] - Coating: If the user is on fire: On tools it grants an autosmelt effect (ores into bars, wood into charcoal); on attacking enemies (melee and bows), set the target on fire for 10 seconds (20 if mastered).
Active
[Active - Hold] - When activated, If player is on fire, breath fire, distinguish the fire. 0MP
Can be used infinitely if the user has lava points in spatial storage

Study ancient magic tomes, reverse engineer them, and create wonders beyond imagination.

Opens a GUI with access to a Spatial Storage. Stackable items in here stack to 128.
Has a slot that instantly smelts entire stacks of objects.
Has a built in crafting table and a custom enchanting table allowing the player to freely add whatever they wish from the list of analyzed enchantments.
Enchanted books have their effects stored to be selected in the enchantment menu.
Maximum bonus level is 1
Gain Mastery by Enchanting or Learning Enchants (Should take 800 enchants/enchanted items to master, without skills that increase mastery gained)
Once mastered, the user automatically gains Godly Craftsman, reducing their magicules accordingly.
